text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival. Amid the excitement of all the 
various events—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! That's a huge crowd... Oh, look, 
Scarlet's here too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka!? Did you come to see the Tiara 
Route Talk Show too?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Tiara Route Talk Show"...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Thought so. *sigh*... It's starting 
soon anyway, so if you're gonna watch, 
stand still and be quiet. Don't distract 
me when I'm being serious."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wha, you're the one getting in my way, 
aren't you!?

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text:
Over here, over here! Big sis is going to 
tell a story over here!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume's Fan
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I'm at the same event as that girl 
again, aren't I...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I am beyond grateful to all of 
you for gathering for our talk show today.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for taking care of me 
last year. As a princess, I—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well, Princess was totally on fire last 
year, for sure! Though she definitely 
didn't act like the quiet, docile type her 
name suggests.

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume's Fan
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. There she goes again, calling 
herself a princess. She's so selfish. Is 
she just trying to stand out by herself?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to the image of the word 
'Princess,' I believe there are many 
aspects... such as loveliness, nobility, 
and purity."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is why, even when we say "princess," 
we imagine different things. And those 
visions will never be the exact same.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...There will be times when we hurt one 
another simply because we are 
'different.'"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, I want to become the princess of 
my own ideals.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There were many things I had to reflect 
on. But there were also things I could be 
proud of. That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Big sis...?

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Don't cry!

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
"I've always admired cool princesses! I 
want to become a princess just like you!!"

The gathered crowd began to buzz. The ring 
of spectators parted naturally, revealing 
a young boy and... a woman within the 
circle.

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Kai-kun!? ...Don't tell me you still want 
to be a princess...

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
Mom! Mom told me... that I could never be 
a princess, that I should just give up, 
but...!

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
I... I still want to become one...! I 
really, truly want to...!

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a princess... just like 
Kawakami Princess, cool, strong, and 
sparkling...!

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that, at least be the 
prince... I mean, you're...
choice_data_list:
...Could that really be true, Kawakami 
Princess?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No! Whether he can become a princess 
depends entirely on his mindset and 
effort!!

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To me, a princess is someone who never 
gives up. Being princess-like is entirely 
a state of mind.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Just as your idea of a princess differs 
from mine, I'm sure... the princess he 
envisions takes a different form as well.
choice_data_list: There is no right or wrong in that.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is precisely why we must 
discipline ourselves, so we don't mistake 
selfishness for being true to ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So that I won't feel ashamed looking back, 
and can continue to be proud of who I am.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Not for anyone else, but for myself.
(Pitter-patter...)

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...I think that's fine too!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume's Fan
text_block_list.text: Wait, you are...

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Her "princess" talk troubled me at the 
press conference, but... She isn't me. She 
is her, and I am me!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I really thought you were wonderful! But 
even more than that, I believe my own 
dream is even more wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So I won't lose in the next race! Let's 
see who's grown more. When there's a race, 
let's face off again!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, with pleasure. Let's give it 
everything we've got in this race!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "...So cool...! This is our... senior...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~... My spine feels completely 
shattered... I was so nervous...
choice_data_list:
Still, she was a “princess” that was “very 
you.”

Still, she was a “princess” that was “very 
you.”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I will hesitate no longer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't be oblivious to causing 
hurt, but you can't be too afraid of it 
either. In order to forge your own path.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To become the "princess I yearn to be," I 
will... become someone I can respect.
choice_data_list:
And you'll become someone others look up 
to, too.

And you'll become someone's idol too, 
won't you?

text_block_list.text:
Just as she aspired to be a princess after 
looking up to PreFie, others will surely 
aspire to be princesses after looking up 
to Kawakami Princess herself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ! ...Fufu, that is true.
(Grrr~...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Why does it have to ring at a time like 
this!? At this rate, I won't be able to 
finish on a high note~!

Kawakami Princess was getting angry at her 
own stomach. But appreciating how much she 
had grown, we toured the food stalls 
together.
(Flap flap flap...!)

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text: You were so cool, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, are you enjoying the festival? There 
is a punching machine competition over 
that way too♪

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!? ...Wait, no, Kai-chan, you 
talked to that lady, right?

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
Shut up. ...Hey, earlier, Mom said 
'sorry.'

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
"...She apologized to me. She said 
sorry... and patted my head. That's why."

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks, Princess! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah. Wait up, Kai-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...I am sure both he and she will make 
wonderful princesses.

—Kawakami Princess's face at that time was 
truly the face of a wonderful princess.
